description.narrative: Projektet syftar till att bidra till förbättrad konkurrenskraft för den serbiska ekonomin, inkluderande och hållbar ekonomisk utveckling och förbättrad levnadsstandard, i linje med EU:s standarder genom åtgärder inom tre huvudpelare: 1) effektivare offentlig upphandling (inklusive ökad användning av gröna och sociala kriterier och ökat förtroende för offentlig upphandling genom bättre efterlevnad och övervakning), 2) förbättrade hållbarhetsprestanda för strategiskt relevanta leveranskedjor genom förbättrat utbud, kvalitet och tillgång till skräddarsydda ESG-relaterade tjänster, och 3) stödja partnerskap och stärka mekanismer för dialogen mellan den offentliga och den privata sektorn.

The project aims to contribute to the improved competitiveness of the Serbian economy, inclusive and sustainable economic development and improved standard of living, in line with EU standards through action in three major pillars of activity: 1) more effective public procurement (including increased use of green and social criteria and increased trust in public procurement through better enforcement and monitoring), 2) improved sustainability performance of strategically relevant supply chains through improved offer, quality and access to tailored ESG-related services, and 3) supporting partnerships and strengthening of public-private dialogue mechanisms.

The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the improved competitiveness of Serbian economy, inclusive and sustainable economic development and improved standard of living, in line with EU standards and requirements of the EU accession process, through:
- Fostering the sustainability of supply chains and compliance with EU's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards as factor of competitiveness of Serbian companies,
- Enhancing social inclusion, gender equality, anti-discrimination, and poverty reduction by integrating social criteria and ethical principles in public procurement, supply chains and social enterprises development,
- Strengthening efficiency, transparency and accountability in public procurement resulting in improved competition, market development and more responsible public spending (value for public money), and
- Further boosting societal dialogue (public-private dialogue) and evidence-based policy making.
The overall objective is expected to be reached by targeting the following specific objectives:
- To enhance the effectiveness and quality of public procurement processes;
- To improve sustainability performances of strategically relevant supply chains and key stakeholders groups through strengthening their capacities and knowledge and improving of offer, quality and access to tailored ESG-related services and
- To improve the quality of dialogue and the capacities of relevant stakeholders to make evidence-based policy decisions.
